welcome:
👋 Hello, {name}!

I can:
🎵 Identify songs from audio, voice, or video
⬇️ Download media from Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and X
🎧 Convert videos to MP3

Pick an option below, or just send me a link or a voice clip.
help_text: 🎵 Find Music — send a voice message, an audio file, or a video and I'll try to identify the song. ⬇️ Download Media — send a public link from Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, or X and I'll show you the download options. 🎧 Convert Video to Audio — send a video (file or link) and I'll extract the audio as MP3. If something doesn't work, I'll tell you exactly why.
ask_send_audio_for_recognition: 🎤 Send a voice message, audio file, or a short video clip and I'll try to identify the song.
recognizing_in_progress: 🎧 Listening… identifying the song, this takes a few seconds.
recognition_no_match: 😕 I couldn't confidently identify this track. It might be too short, too noisy, or not in the database. Try a longer or clearer clip.
recognition_low_confidence_prefix: ⚠️ I'm not fully sure, but this might be it:
recognition_error: ⚠️ Music recognition failed right now. Please try again in a moment.
recognition_file_too_long: ⚠️ That file is quite long — I'll only analyze the first {seconds} seconds.
ask_send_link: 🔗 Send me a public link from Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, or X.
choose_download_option: 📥 Choose what you'd like to download:
choose_download_option_carousel: 🖼 This post has {count} images. Choose one, or download all.
sending_large_file_link:
📦 This file is larger than Telegram allows for direct delivery. Here's a secure temporary download link (expires in {minutes} minutes):
{url}
choose_video_action: 🎬 What would you like to do with this video?
error_unsupported_platform: ❌ Sorry, I don't support this link yet. Supported platforms: Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X.
error_platform_disabled: ❌ Downloads from this platform are temporarily disabled by the admin.
error_unsafe_url: ❌ That link isn't valid or safe to fetch. Please double-check it.
error_private_content: 🔒 This content is private or requires login, so I can't access it.
error_content_not_found: ❌ I couldn't find this content — it may have been deleted, or the link is invalid.
error_rate_limited: ⏱ The platform is rate-limiting requests right now. Please try again in a bit.
error_file_too_large: ❌ This file ({size_mb:.0f} MB) exceeds the {limit_mb} MB limit and can't be processed.
error_download_failed: ❌ Download failed. Please try again, or try a different link.
error_download_timeout: ⌛ This is taking too long and timed out. Please try again.
error_media_invalid: ❌ That file doesn't look like a valid audio/video file.
error_ffmpeg: ❌ Something went wrong while processing the media. Please try again.
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
error_rate_limit_user: ⏱ You're sending requests too quickly. Please wait {seconds}s and try again.
error_file_too_big_to_fetch: ❌ That file is larger than {limit_mb} MB, which is the maximum I can download from Telegram.
error_banned: 🚫 You've been restricted from using this bot. Contact the admin if you think this is a mistake.
error_maintenance: 🛠 The bot is under maintenance right now. Please try again soon.
job_queued: ✅ Got it, working on it now…
admin_not_authorized: 🚫 This section is for admins only.
